notes: §1985:XIII.4.5.4 GR2: 'When a file is not in an open mode, no statement may be executed which references the file, either explicitly or implicitly, except for an OPEN statement'; 1985 states no result. ScreenReportFileReference refuses READ of a report file at compile time (COBOL2577); at run time Initiate asks OpenModeIfOpen and takes no action on a closed file, FileConnector.Close gives 42 and the USE procedure runs, and a repeated OPEN gives 41 (RefusedAsAlreadyOpen). Probes at 85: TERMINATE, INITIATE and GENERATE before any OPEN, and GENERATE and TERMINATE after CLOSE of an active report, run with no output and no abend; CLOSE not open 42 and double OPEN 41, each through USE AFTER ERROR; a later OPEN works. Witness: OPENED, CLOSED.

next.reason: The ban is the same for report files. 2023 §2023:14.9.27.4 GR6 adds exceptions ('except for a MERGE or SORT statement with the USING or GIVING phrase, the COMMIT and ROLLBACK statements, a DELETE FILE statement, or an OPEN statement'), but SORT, MERGE and DELETE FILE cannot name a report file (§2023:13.18.46.3 SR3; 1985 XIII.3.3.3 SR3 likewise) and COMMIT/ROLLBACK are not 1985 statements, so the store's reason does not change a 1985 program; §2023:14.9.27.4 GR8 restates the open-mode requirement. What changed: 1985 leaves undefined an INITIATE that implicitly references a report file not in an open mode; 2023 §2023:14.9.21.4 GR3 sets EC-REPORT-FILE-MODE and takes no action on the report.
